:::{#def-complex-conjugate}
#### Complex conjugate

The **complex conjugate** of a complex number $z = a + b\,i$ (@def-complex-number) is

$$\overline{z} \eqdef a - b\,i.$$

:::

::: notes
@axler2024linear [Definition 4.2, p. 120] gives the same definition, as $\overline{z} = \operatorname{Re} z - (\operatorname{Im} z)\,i$.
:::
